announcements.headline: Administrators appointed to Distil Company Limited
announcements.insight: Administrators have been appointed following the CEO's resignation and suspension. Shareholders face total loss of equity value as the company enters insolvency proceedings.

announcements.headline: Intends to Appoint Admin'rs to Subsid; CEO resigns
announcements.insight: Following suspension in October, the CEO resignation and appointment of administrators confirm insolvency proceedings. Shareholders face total loss of equity value.

announcements.headline: Suspension - Distil Plc
announcements.insight: Shares are suspended following the September funding update. Shareholders must await further developments regarding the company's financial position and potential restructuring.

announcements.headline: Delay in Annual Results; update ; funding progress
announcements.insight: Distil delays annual results while updating on funding progress. This follows recent directorate changes and distribution appointments.

announcements.headline: Directorate change
announcements.insight: Distil has changed its directorate. This follows recent updates on distribution management and US orders.

announcements.headline: Result of AGM
announcements.insight: Shareholders should note the AGM results follow recent governance updates including related party transactions and board appointments.

announcements.headline: U.S Order for Blavod
announcements.insight: Distil secured a U.S. order for Blavod, following its July distribution appointment. This expands market reach but lacks financial detail.

announcements.headline: Notice of AGM; Proposed Capital Reorganisation
Appointment of Fortitude to manage UK distribution
announcements.insight: Distil appoints Fortitude to manage UK distribution. This follows the July Ardgowan update and June CLN conversion.

announcements.headline: Ardgowan Update
announcements.insight: Ardgowan Update follows the June CLN conversion. Shareholders should monitor for further related party transaction developments.

announcements.headline: Early CLN Conversion; Related Party Transactions
announcements.insight: Distil announces an early CLN conversion and related party transactions. This suggests significant capital structure changes or potential insolvency proceedings affecting shareholder value.
